cccd.toastErrorMessage: The image is invalid or unclear, please try again.
cccd.verifyFailedMessage: ID verification failed. Please try again.
cccd.verifiedDescription: Your citizen identity information has been recorded and is ready for the rental or owner registration process.
cccd.infoDescription: This data is used to cross-check your profile and reduce transaction risk.
cccd.storedNote: Your ID card has been verified and stored securely.
cccd.pendingDescription: Your ID card image has been submitted. Staff will review it and update the result as soon as possible.
cccd.pendingPanelDescription: You can return to this page to check the progress.
cccd.pendingNote: This application needs manual review by staff. While waiting, you do not need to upload again if the image is clear and shows the correct document.
cccd.uploadDescription: Upload a clear front-side photo so the system can read it with OCR and send it to staff for review when needed. Better photos are processed faster.
cccd.tip2Description: Front side of your ID card
cccd.frontPanelDescription: Drag and drop an image into the frame or choose one from your computer.
cccd.dropzoneTitle: Drag and drop an image here or click to choose
cccd.dropzoneDescription: Supports JPG, PNG. Use a sharp, well-lit photo.
cccd.guideDescription: The clearer the photo, the faster AI and staff can process it.
cccd.guideItem1: Keep the document fully inside the frame with no cropped corners.
cccd.guideItem2: Avoid glare or shadows covering the text.
cccd.guideItem3: Capture on a flat surface with good contrast.
cccd.guideItem4: Do not use blurry, shaky or heavily edited images.
cccd.privacyNote: Document data is used for account verification and transaction risk control.
